title: Bram and the Border
author: Lena Dunmore
blurb: Ivo Ishikawa, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
